descricao_original: Anaphase begins as sister chromatids separate, drawn toward each centrosome by spindle fibers of the spindle apparatus. The process continues until late anaphase at which time the chromosomes have segregated to the poles in the eventual daughter cells. Whitefish blastula, 1500x
